subject: Compliance kickoff: SOC 2 status, BAA availability, and deployment routing
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medicore.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@medicore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & actions from today's compliance kickoff

Hi Elaine / Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of the items we discussed and owners for the next week: 

1) SOC 2 status: Medicore asked where Redwood stands on SOC 2 attestation and whether we can share a current report. (Owner: Redwood — Marissa to share summary and redacted report)

2) BAA availability: Medicore asked whether Redwood will sign a BAA and which hosting modes are eligible for PHI (hosted API with BAA, Dedicated, Private VPC). (Owner: Redwood — Sofia & Karthik to confirm permitted hosting options and any limitations)

3) Vendor security questionnaire: Medicore will send a spreadsheet XLSX for their InfoSec team; Redwood to complete or provide a supporting packet. (Owner: Medicore — Sam to send; Owner: Redwood — Marissa to populate answers)

4) Technical deep dive: Medicore requested a 60-min call with our infra engineer to walk through network segmentation and key management for Private deployments. (Owner: Medicore & Redwood — coordinate availability)

Attachments I will circulate: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (high-level), BAA-draft-Medicore-v1.docx (template), Vendor-Questionnaire.xlsx (when provided by Medicore).

Next immediate asks for you, Elaine / Sam:
- Confirm whether Medicore's InfoSec will accept a redacted SOC 2 report or requires the full attestation packet.
- Share the vendor questionnaire spreadsheet (if not already on its way).

I will follow up by EOD tomorrow with the redacted SOC2 summary and a short note on probable deployment modes that can handle PHI.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@medicore.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & actions from today's compliance kickoff

Thanks, Sofia. Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can accept a redacted SOC 2 as long as it clearly indicates the scope (in-scope services, dates, auditor). If you can include the control matrix summary that helps our review.
- We'll send the vendor questionnaire attached to this thread by EOD (it includes questions on encryption, data retention, and third-party subprocessors).
- On the BAA: our legal prefers an executed BAA before we route PHI through any third party. We understand there are hosting distinctions — please confirm which deployment modes Redwood will permit for PHI once BAA is in place.

I'll loop in our security contact: security@medicorepartners.com (cc'd). Look forward to Marissa's packet.

Best,
Sam
Head of Product Operations | Medicore Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@medicore.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@medicore.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood compliance packet (SOC2 summary + draft BAA)

Hi Elaine / Sam —

Per Sofia's note, attached is a short SOC 2 summary and a draft BAA for Medicore to review. Quick notes: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for the period 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. We are currently in our 2026 readiness phase and expect the 2026 attestation to be completed in Q1 2027. The attached PDF is a redacted summary that includes scope and control highlights.

- BAA: The attached document (BAA-draft-Medicore-v1.docx) is our standard template. High-level options for PHI handling we can support once an executed BAA is in place: 
  * Hosted (Redwood API): BAA available for enterprise accounts with additional contractual controls and account-level isolation; suitable for low-latency use cases with standard PHI flows.
  * Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools in our Dedicated offering can be isolated to a single tenant and are allowed for PHI per contract.
  * Private (VPC / on-prem): Full private deployment with customer-managed network and KMS/HSM integration — recommended for highest assurance and regulated deployments.

Constraints / notes: 
- Our hosted API has multi-tenant infrastructure for shared customers; when PHI is required we require an enterprise contract and specific configuration (see BAA, Section 3).
- Private deployments can support stricter data residency and network controls but will require an onboarding window and an ops runbook.

Attachments in this email: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (redacted), BAA-draft-Medicore-v1.docx (editable). I will start populating the vendor questionnaire once Sam sends it — happy to turn around answers in 2 business days for the first pass.

If you'd like, we can schedule the technical deep dive next week (Karthik, can you propose 2 times?)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood compliance packet (SOC2 summary + draft BAA)

Thanks, Marissa and team — quick coordination note and proposed next steps from infra / deployment POV: 

1) Technical deep dive: available slots (PST): Tue 2026-09-14 10:00-11:00, Wed 2026-09-15 13:00-14:00. We can cover network segmentation, KV management (KMS/HSM patterns), and the Private deployment onboarding roadmap. Please confirm which slot works for Medicore.

2) PHI routing by deployment mode (summary):
   - Hosted API (with executed BAA + enterprise config): acceptable for controller/processor flows where Medicore controls keys and data retention policies are applied at account-level. Not recommended if you require dedicated hardware.
   - Dedicated (single-tenant GPU pools): acceptable and recommended for predictable throughput and stronger isolation guarantees.
   - Private (VPC/on-prem): acceptable for highest compliance needs; requires separate provisioning and will have an onboarding lead time (~4-6 weeks).

3) Vendor questionnaire: once Sam provides the spreadsheet, Marissa will populate answers and I will review any technical clarifications before we return it. Estimated turnaround: initial pass in 2 business days after receipt.

4) Next milestone: aim to have a mutually agreed BAA version and completed questionnaire by 2026-09-22 so Medicore InfoSec can start internal routing.

Action items:
- Medicore: send vendor questionnaire (Sam) and indicate preferred deep-dive slot (Elaine).
- Redwood: Marissa to upload SOC2 redacted report to shared Drive; Karthik to prepare infra runbook for Private deployment.

Looking forward — happy to jump on a short sync if any of the items above need re-prioritization.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Principal Product PM, Deployments | Redwood Inference
